RFG Advisory Group LLC Has $2.31 Million Stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Anthony Miller | Feb 6th, 2018 
RFG Advisory Group LLC increased its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 4.6% during the 3rd quarter, according to its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The firm owned 14,821 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 656 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises about 1.4% of RFG Advisory Group LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 13th biggest position. RFG Advisory Group LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $2,309,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period. 
Several other institutional investors and hedge funds have also recently modified their holdings of the stock. West Coast Financial LLC raised its position in Apple by 26.4% in the third quarter. West Coast Financial LLC now owns 86,482 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $13,329,000 after purchasing an additional 18,066 shares during the period. One Capital Management LLC raised its position in Apple by 1.3% in the third quarter. One Capital Management LLC now owns 38,314 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,905,000 after purchasing an additional 506 shares during the period. Thomas Story & Son LLC raised its position in Apple by 100.0% in the third quarter. Thomas Story & Son LLC now owns 5,650 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $871,000 after purchasing an additional 2,825 shares during the period. Trillium Asset Management LLC raised its position in Apple by 1.8% in the third quarter. Trillium Asset Management LLC now owns 102,235 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $15,756,000 after purchasing an additional 1,765 shares during the period. Finally, Private Vista LLC raised its position in Apple by 38.7% in the third quarter. Private Vista LLC now owns 3,719 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $574,000 after purchasing an additional 1,038 shares during the period. 60.23% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ AAPL ) opened at $156.49 on Tuesday. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple Inc. has a 52 week low of $128.90 and a 52 week high of $180.10. The company has a market capitalization of $814,379.13, a P/E ratio of 16.08, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.28 and a beta of 1.31. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the firm posted $3.36 earnings per share. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. equities research analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.3 EPS for the current year. 
The business also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th will be paid a $0.63 dividend. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 1.61%. Apple’s payout ratio is currently 25.90%.

Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
